About Us

ProtoMed is a renowned medical billing company and a dedicated partner in healthcare administration. We focus on bridging the gap between clinical excellence and financial health, allowing healthcare providers to move their focus away from cumbersome paperwork.

Our Story

We offer premium medical billing services and revenue cycle management (RCM) solutions throughout the United States.

Our certified medical billing experts are trained in utilizing a specialized billing ecosystem to perform everything from precise medical coding and provider enrollment to tenacious accounts receivable (A/R) recovery. We operate natively within your current EHR/EMR so you experience a smooth transition to medical billing that optimizes the profitability of your practice while adhering to the highest standards of HIPAA compliant medical billing.
